title: Chapter 319: Order, Attack
content:
Chapter 319: Order, Attack

Coincidentally, next to Wang Shuo's defense zone is the area defended by Wu'an Town.

This Wu'an Town is the town built by Dongfang Ling and Fang Kai.

At this time, Dongfang Ling did not go up to the city wall.

Fang Kai walked over with a proud look on his face.

"You are Wang Shuo, right? I warn you, it's best to stay away from Dongfang Ling. He is not someone you can approach."

Wang Shuo felt a little puzzled.

"Who are you?"

Wang Shuo thought that this was just a follower of Dongfang Ling. What qualifications did he have to yell in front of him?

Wang Shuo retorted without any hesitation.

"Who I am, you don't need to care, you just need to remember my words, that's all."

After that, he turned and left.

The main reason is that he is only a senior general now. Seeing Ye Tianba and others behind Wang Shuo, he left with a harsh word and walked away tactfully.

Wang Shuo did not take him seriously. Even Ni Wu was dealt with by him. This so-called elite from outside the domain is nothing more than that.

…

Death is not scary, what is scary is the despair of waiting to die.

A few days passed, and the undead still showed no signs of attacking the city.

Wang Shuo took the time to go to the county governor's mansion again and had a good chat with Zhao Bangde.

"The undead are waiting to summon their king."

Seeing Wang Shuo's puzzled face, Zhao Bangde explained.

"Black Dragon King?"

Zhao Bangde nodded.

"Then why don't we take the initiative and fight out?"

"Do you think I don't want to! However, the strength of our two sides is very different. If we fight head-on, we have almost no chance of winning."

"But if it drags on like this, won't we have no chance of winning?"

"At least we still have the city wall to defend, the undead are just plotting." Zhao Bangde sighed.

Wang Shuo also felt a sense of powerlessness.

Fortunately, there is no shortage of water and food here, so it doesn't matter how long the siege lasts.

However, being worried and tense every day is a bit unbearable.

Next to the altar of the undead.

"Report to the general, we don't have enough sacrifices."

The skeleton general sitting on the throne had a golden mask on his face.

After hearing the report from his men, he stood up and looked at Shanhai City from afar.

"Let's take this city first and then offer it to the king!" Arif Ubol said casually.

"Send the order, attack." At this time, a skeleton soldier shouted with a hoarse voice.

Ten huge human skin war drums were brought up.

Ten skeleton soldiers, 3 meters tall, swung huge animal bones in their hands and hit the drums violently.

"Bang... Bang..."

The huge drum sound resounded throughout the land.

When the human defenders on the city wall heard the drum sound, their hearts seemed to beat along with it.

Then, the bells in the city also rang, and everyone entered a state of preparation for war.

At the same time, the war in the other two county cities was about to break out.

There are a total of three counties in the Dahuai area, namely Hedong County, Nanxuanfu, and Fenglin County.

They were surrounded by the three undead legions, namely the Burning Legion, the Blood Legion, and the Purple Flame Legion.

At this moment, they launched an attack at the same time.

This siege was different from the small fights Wang Shuo had seen before. The entire attack was orderly.

The first to attack were still cannon fodder skeletons, mainly various large undead beasts.

The 3-meter-tall undead tigers were covered with a layer of snake skin, the giant pythons over 30 meters long, the huge porcupines 5 meters long, and various tall undead beasts, taking heavy steps, approaching the walls of Shanhai City.

Every step was earth-shaking, and even trampled on some weak skeletons around them.

In the distance, the main force of the Burning Legion still stood in place, silently waiting for the order to attack.

Standing on the wall, Wang Shuo witnessed all this, and felt his heart surge and his blood boiling.

This grand battlefield scene, for the timid, is probably terrifying.

But for Wang Shuo, it just ignited his passion, and he became excited.

He wanted to shout: "For glory!"
